audit.summary: 95 land declarations include technical states
audit.result: CONFIRM: independently counted 95/155/180/121. These are declarations, not accessible-world counts.

audit.result: CONFIRM: ACCONLY calls isLandIngame; landUnlocked is separate. Do not infer adjacency from availability.

audit.summary: Per-carrier travel preview

corrections.summary: Delivery checkpoints are all PARTIAL, not blocked installs. Remnant II and KH delivered installed-byte reads; their own build pins remain dated lane evidence, not a new live install verification.
REPORT and FINDINGS reuse F3/F4/F5 for different summaries. Audit IDs here cite FINDINGS IDs; downstream references must name file plus ID. No audit correction was applied to lane files.

Mixed shown+stated labels must be split by clause. Realm behavior and favor text are descriptions; archive/chunk/native/table evidence proves only the inspected structures. Five shown checks here use structural subclaims, including three from SU-F13.

Every parsed claim stays conditional on the unvalidated build match of Mappings.usmap. Successful JSON emission or no logged error is not a complete schema validation. ActivateFirstValidWorld is activation, not random selection.

Room/member/model changes are not evidence of retained local stock, consent or personal memory. SaveData is tool-side schema, not Steam-container compatibility. Census counts remain selected artifacts, not campaign count.

SHOWN means inspected rules/examples, not a software implementation. Public preview does not establish full personal-recursion creation rules. Translation and unchanged physical passage are distinct source options.

Only four FINDINGS IDs are labeled SHOWN. Five concrete claims were checked by splitting F11 into room setup and hidden-exit semantics. Tutorial and web-client code do not become current server source; RetroMUD mechanics remain STATED.
Screenshots establish visible information only. Retain no-map/no-parallel-world/no-save-proof limits. 1920x1080 media or arithmetic scaling cannot pass YAIRPG 1366x768 gate.

Current 2026-10-15 OD2/OD4/OD5/OD6/OD7 accepted direction supersedes older unresolved/default wording: memories/base cheat between lives, chosen away routines with stops, paused inactive worlds, means-based returns/fresh versions, continuing self and causal world stories. These are accepted goals, not implemented semantics. Across-life and across-world retention remain different contracts.

Older lane UI suggestions cannot replace accepted Proto23 composition or occupy another panel. Follow UI_RULES: surface/home, shared components/controller, log intact, bottom Back/Esc. Unaccepted features stay in Projects until promoted.
